ui.scope: Real source interface in headless Chromium with isolated in-memory native task transport; no live network writes
checks: Delivered package exposes explicit authorization while attachment alone remains unauthorized
Exact map/task/version/hash confirmation can be cancelled without changing authority
Confirmed exact package exposes copy and download actions with durable authorization
Explicit return check stages a valid result while Auto-Sync stays Off; duplicate bytes produce one readable result with both provenances
Untrusted attachment names render as text, with no image/HTML execution or map application
Read-only delivery view reflects authorization uncertainty as Deferred without importing or claiming implementation
Fixed instructions use clipboard or selectable fallback; no model/generation/message call is made
Review shows the packaged original, current saved content and returned values without applying them
Explicit full-value read displays the complete long dialogue without importing or applying it
Reject confirmation records a durable hold and manual processing cannot bypass it
Retry preserves the content conflict; cancelling explicit overwrite does not apply it
Explicit complete-group approval applies through normal validation and leaves the task open, testing Unreviewed and Auto-Sync Off
Three-way comparison wraps inside the existing modal at 620-pixel height without footer overlap or horizontal overflow
Fixture service initializes with Auto-Sync Off and no network calls
Native package status/manual discovery route works without a linked package and makes no network request
Native manual check rejects a stale renderer map context
Review preview/full-value native routes reject unrecognized retained packages without network access
Suspend/resume, update quiescence, checkpoint and shutdown drain discovery without network calls or leaked timers

transportProof: Isolated synthetic native/private-metadata transports; unchanged real transport already exercised in U25
